verdict.rationale: pnpm is a package manager and script runner. Scheduling recurring jobs or workflows is a CI or orchestration capability outside its category, and nothing in the evidence shows pnpm shipping any scheduler, cron, or recurring-trigger feature. Its CI-related docs cover one-off install behavior such as frozen-lockfile mode, not recurring schedules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
